name: Brusselator

slots.Xi: concentrations of the two intermediates: concentrations in R_+^2
slots.C: well-stirred open reactor; the feeds a and b are held by the reservoirs
slots.P: bounded write toward a target, release, measurement; sweep of b
slots.A: a=1, b=3; control b in (1.0, 4.0); noise D=0.01

provenance: Prigogine and Lefever, J. Chem. Phys. 48, 1695 (1968)
loss_law: no stable state: a limit cycle, whose phase diffuses (Law 2 along the cycle)

events.kind: Hopf: the unwritten state starts to oscillate

required: The critical eigenvalues cross as a complex pair: the unwritten state starts to oscillate and no state is chosen. A memory needs the loop of couplings to compose to a map with a fixed point (a positive loop), or reciprocal couplings.

verdict.stores: no stable state: a limit cycle, whose phase diffuses (Law 2 along the cycle)
verdict.constructs: Hopf bifurcation: the state oscillates and no stable state is selected; information is kept in the phase
verdict.holds: no stable state: a limit cycle, whose phase diffuses (Law 2 along the cycle)
